comments.comment: Not a big fan of ESPN but this is a great video. My son Kevin Yoder was a very accomplished wide receiver for Guntersville Tigers in Alabama. He was going into his senior year as a varsity starter and even though he didn't expect to get a scholarship for his favorite school University of Alabama or any others, he had hoped to be a walk on (run on). His coaches indicated that he had what it took to get the scholarship and surely would have gotten the walk on at the very least. Unfortunately on April 20, 2012 at around 6:30 pm, at 17 Kevin's life was cut short as he was traveling across northern Mississippi headed to Arkansas with his pole vaulting coach, her father (team booster), and two of his teammates. They were headed to a weekend clinic on pole vaulting. They ran into a freak thunderstorm downpour and hydroplaned into two trees killing my son straight away and seriously injuring two others. It was the absolute worst day of my life that has not yet ended. So today I sincerely wish each and every walk on who inspires to suit up and play the game the best of luck to you to always be able to play your best game ever.            Timothy Yoder
